study: NHANES self-report questionnaire reduction, redesigned age/sex base
created_local: 2026-10-23 Asia/Shanghai; before first new model fit

resolution_record.decision_basis: OHQ770 excluded before fitting to resolve questionnaire routing dependency.

endpoint: CDC/AAP moderate or severe, raw audited scalar classification
path_rule: Visit units in raw aggregated-importance rank order; recursively insert any unmet prerequisite immediately before child; take each feasible prefix k=0..U. Report raw rank separately from constrained path order.
income: INDFMIN2 nominal categorical; 12/13 valid coarse brackets; no other income representation

missingness.categorical: Separate REFUSED, UNKNOWN, SYSTEM_MISSING; OHQ770 excluded by direct user instruction; raw routing retained only in audit. Codebook categories define validity before modeling.
missingness.days: Median imputation fit in each training domain; separate refused/unknown/system-missing indicators.
missingness.smoking: 020=2 Never regardless legitimate skipped040; 020=1 &040=3 Former; 020=1 &040 in [1,2] Current; retain unknown/refused/system states.
missingness.diabetes: DIQ010=3 Borderline is a valid independent category

cv.group: original stratum+PSU; duplicated copies never split
cv.stratification: participant CDC/AAP target label, not survey stratum; survey stratum retained for resampling
cv.selection_score: unweighted mean across folds of survey-weighted fold AUC
cv.tie_break: first parameter-grid entry, strict >; importance ties use frozen candidate order

ebm_internal_validation: 4 explicit GroupShuffleSplit PSU-disjoint bags, 15% group holdout; retry deterministically until both classes present; each bag shares training-domain preprocessing, no outer evaluation observations used
attribution: Native additive EBM or exact XGBoost pred_contribs; signed encoded-column sums per information unit then survey-weighted mean absolute value; rank only candidate units, Base always retained

thresholds.outer: Each outer-training domain inner3 OOF Logistic predictions; ranks selected within outer-training domain. These inner predictions are model-fit OOF conditional on source-selected units, not fully selection-independent. Outer evaluation remains isolated.
thresholds.final: Full development nested outer OOF pipeline predictions for corresponding algorithm and k; threshold is highest finite probability achieving weighted sensitivity>=.90; freeze before H evaluation
thresholds.pooled_source_screening: Use each held-out individual fold-specific inner-training threshold; do not reselect pooled-source threshold to report held-out screening

metrics.calibration: joint intercept and slope; not fixed-slope1 calibration-in-the-large; weighted risk deciles, preserve score ties
metrics.Brier: original probabilities, same evaluation individuals and survey weights

bootstrap.method: Rao-Wu rescaled; full survey design within stratum draw m-1 PSUs with replacement, multiply frequencies by m/(m-1), then map to analysis domain
bootstrap.source_implementation: Literal repeated source rows, scale applied once, all copies retain original PSU group. Retune EBM and XGBoost with frozen source3 grids every replicate. No downstream budget model refits.
bootstrap.target: fixed probabilities, models, units, cutoffs; paired draws for all budgets
bootstrap.intervals: 2.5/97.5 percentile pointwise, no joint-curve or noninferiority claim
bootstrap.stability: raw topk and dependency-feasible topk separately; full rank distribution, selection frequency, Spearman/Kendall agreement, Nogueira and pairwise Jaccard

source_discussion_candidates: Descriptive feasible-path budgets at 80%/90% source importance concentration and source AUC/Brier/unit-count nondominance; no required optimal length, no one-SE or clinical loss threshold, no target-based choice
